{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Dark| type2=Psychic| trainername=James| pokemonname=Inkay| jtrainername=コジロウ| jpokemonname=マーイーカ | tmtrainername=Kojirō| tmpokemonname=Maaiika| image=[[File:James Inkay.png|250px]] | caption=James's Inkay | gender=MaleConfirmed in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]''.| location={{rt|4|Kalos}} | epnum=XY003 | epname=A Battle of Aerial Mobility! | prevonum=686| current=[[Party|With James]]| enva1=[[Mike Liscio]]| java1=[[Kenta Miyake]]| }} '''James's Inkay''' (Japanese: '''コジロウのマーイーカ''' ''Kojirō's Maaiika'') is the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[James]] caught in the [[Kalos]] [[region]], and his twelfth overall. ==In animation== ==={{aniseries|XY}}=== [[File:James Inkay eating.png|thumb|left|250px|Inkay eating a croissant]] Inkay first appeared in ''[[XY003|A Battle of Aerial Mobility!]]'' while {{TRT}} was dining at a café in [[Lumiose City]]. As Team Rocket was busy celebrating news from {{an|Giovanni}}, Inkay stole their food and proceeded to eat it from under their table. While Team Rocket was in their balloon, the same Inkay from before approached them when they dropped their sandwich and sprayed ink at them. After Team Rocket cleaned themselves off, James scanned the Inkay to get some details about him and the Team Rocket trio attempted to battle him with {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}. However, James offered Inkay some food instead as bait. While Inkay was distracted, James threw a Poké Ball at him and {{pkmn2|caught}} him, much to the surprise of [[Jessie]] and {{MTR}}. In ''[[XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!]]'', he was sent out for the first time to help capture {{AP|Pikachu}} and a {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}, but the two managed to evade them. When the two were rescued by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, Team Rocket arrived and James sent Inkay out again to battle Dedenne, who was under {{an|Clemont}}'s command. The two proved to be evenly matched until Dedenne used {{m|Nuzzle}} on Inkay, {{status|paralysis|paralyzing}} him and allowing Dedenne and {{AP|Pikachu}} to defeat him by combining their respective {{m|Thunder Shock}} and {{m|Thunderbolt}}. [[File:XY029.png|thumb|250px|Inkay and James disguised as Pikachu and Ash]] In ''[[XY029|Heroes - Friends and Faux Alike!]]'', Inkay was part of Team Rocket's plan to impersonate Ash and his friends. Inkay disguised itself as Pikachu alongside his Trainer, who masqueraded as Ash. James met a boy called {{OBP|Myron|XY029}} and his {{p|Pancham}} and asked for a battle, to which Myron declined. James had Inkay attack Pancham with his {{m|Psybeam}} and {{m|Tackle}} anyway, which caused Myron to call for [[Officer Jenny]]. Inkay was later seen helping Team Rocket eat a bunch of food and running off without paying. In ''[[XY054|Facing the Grand Design!]]'', Inkay was enjoying lunch with his Trainer until they noticed Ash and his friends walk by, and Team Rocket started coming up with a plan to catch {{AP|Pikachu}}. Later, Team Rocket found a group of {{p|Malamar}} and Inkay in the forest. As they were watching the Pokémon, three trucks drove by, each containing a {{an|Malamar}}, one of which was the one that had [[XY019|previously hypnotized him]]. Inkay immediately chased after the trucks and followed them up a mountainside. Team Rocket watched the Malamar for a while until Inkay got upset and started a commotion, getting the attention of the Malamar. Team Rocket fled and ran into Ash and his friends before being stopped by Officer Jenny, who filled them in on Malamar's plans. Two of the Malamar arrived and attempted to kidnap everyone with their {{m|Psychic}}, but Inkay attacked with his Ink Spray, allowing a few of them to escape. Inkay planned on going straight back to confront the Malamar, but Clemont changed Inkay's mind, knowing the group wouldn't stand a chance. Inkay then came with an idea to talk to the group of Inkay and Malamar they saw before to get them to help out. [[File:James Inkay attacking evil Malamar.png|thumb|left|250px|Inkay attacking the evil Malamar]] Inkay started to tell them of the evil Malamar's plan, but was stopped by that Malamar showing up and attacking them. The Malamar and Inkay chased it off with their {{m|Psycho Cut}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}, then headed to the mountainside to stop its plans. Once they arrived, the evil Malamar grabbed Inkay and used his {{m|Hypnosis}} to brainwash Inkay into attacking the others. However, James managed to break Inkay out of it because of the strong bond they share, allowing Inkay to attack Malamar. They managed to stop the Malamar's evil plan, but it escaped during the fight. Afterwards, Team Rocket was back to resting in the forest and Inkay was offered to join the Malamar and Inkay they saved. James allowed Inkay to stay with them, but Inkay instead decided to stick with his Trainer, much to his delight. [[File:James and Inkay.png|thumb|250px|Inkay and James]] In ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', Inkay partnered up with [[Jessie's Gourgeist]] in a dance party hosted by [[Monsieur Pierre]]. Later, Inkay was used in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] along with [[Miette's Slurpuff]], where he faced Ash's Pikachu and [[Serena's Eevee]]. Inkay tried hitting Pikachu with Psybeam, but Pikachu dodged it and Inkay ended up getting hit by an {{m|Iron Tail}} from him. Inkay then used Psybeam on Pikachu and Eevee, which they dodged. This, however, allowed Slurpuff to trap them with {{m|Cotton Spore}}, giving Inkay the opportunity to hit them with another Psybeam. Inkay then headed towards Eevee using Tackle, but Pikachu stepped in and took the attack. After a collision between Eevee and Slurpuff's attacks, Inkay struck Eevee again with a Psybeam. After Eevee's [[Evolution]] into Sylveon, Sylveon easily dodged Inkay's Tackles and then defeated him and Slurpuff with {{m|Fairy Wind}}. In ''[[XY107|An Explosive Operation!]]'', Inkay was used to protect [[Z2]] from [[Team Flare]]. Inkay used Psybeam to stop Team Flare's weapon from firing. Later, he fought Team Flare again along with Wobbuffet and Gourgeist. He managed to hit [[Mable]]'s {{p|Weavile}} with Psybeam, but was then struck by [[Aliana]]'s {{p|Druddigon}}'s {{m|Slash}}. He and Gourgeist were then defeated by the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s' Pokémon's combined attacks. When Team Rocket, Serena, [[Mairin]], and [[Professor Sycamore]] infiltrated [[Lysandre Labs]] in ''[[XY134|The Right Hero for the Right Job!]]'', Inkay was sent out, alongside Gourgeist, to battle [[Celosia]]'s {{p|Drapion}}. Inkay was sent out in ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'' to fight the Megalith {{p|Zygarde}}, fending off its roots to clear the way for Ash and [[Alain]]. One of the roots, however, blasted Inkay and his Team members out of the helicopter, but they were saved by [[Diantha's Gardevoir]]. In ''[[XY137|Battling with a Clean Slate!]]'', Inkay battled Ash and {{ashfr}} for the final time in Kalos, fighting alongside Gourgeist against [[Ash's Greninja]] and [[Alain's Charizard]]. Greninja and Charizard were able to make quick work of the two and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Following the Team Rocket trio's journey in [[Kalos]], James left Inkay at {{an|Team Rocket HQ}}. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'', Inkay, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at Team Rocket HQ, were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Inkay was one of the many Pokémon that waited at the end of the trap, where he ambushed an isolated Pikachu. When the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon returned, Inkay joined them to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and Wobbuffet ended up sending it back with {{m|Mirror Coat}}. A wild {{an|Latias}} that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:James Inkay Ink Spray.png|thumb|250px|Inkay shooting ink]] Inkay appears to be a sneaky and mischievous Pokémon, as he was seen stealing food from Team Rocket and then followed them in their balloon. He seems to love food and would often go out of his way to steal it, to the point of allowing James to use this to his advantage and capture it. This was shown again in ''[[XY049|Bonnie for the Defense!]]'' where he went out of his Poké Ball on his own just to eat Team Rocket's food. He is also shown to be thankful for the other Inkay and Malamar in helping them to stop the evil Malamar by being like a hero to them. Inkay is also a powerful and resourceful battler, shown in ''[[XY008|Grooming Furfrou!]]'' and ''[[XY033|Calling from Beyond the Aura!]]''. He was able to beat [[Officer Jenny]]'s {{p|Manectric}} with ease and then prevented {{AP|Pikachu}} from attacking him by spraying him with ink in the former and easily knocked out {{TP|Clemont|Bunnelby}} with Tackle in the latter. He had no problem listening to his Trainer after he was caught. In ''[[XY054|Facing the Grand Design!]]'', he has a strong bond with his Trainer similar to that of {{Ash}} and his Pikachu. In fact, it was so strong that James was able to break him free of Malamar's {{m|Hypnosis}} by using a croissant. He also has a great relationship with Team Rocket, to the point of wanting to protect them from the evil Malamar and avenge them for being controlled by the evil Malamar previously. Ever since his previous encounter with the evil Malamar, Inkay has formed a deep grudge against it and has sworn to get his revenge while stopping it from fulfilling its dark plans of destroying the world. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|dark|psychic|James Inkay {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Tackle|1=Psybeam|2=Foul Play}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Tackle|1=Psybeam|2=Foul Play}}}} {{anmov|normal|Tackle|XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!}} {{anmov|psychic|Psybeam|XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!}} {{anmov|dark|Foul Play|XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!}} {{anmov/f|psychic}} ====Moves improvised==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{dark color}}; border: 3px solid #{{psychic color dark}}; {{roundy}}" |- ! {{color|FFF|Picture}} ! {{color|FFF|First Used In}} ! {{color|FFF|Moves Involved}} ! {{color|FFF|Partnered With}} |- style="background:#FFF" | rowspan="2" | [[File:Ash Serena Team Rocket combo.png|150px]] | ''[[XY063|A Fork in the Road! ''{{color2|000|Pokémon the Series: XY}}'' |} ==In the manga== [[File:James Inkay Jessie Pumpkaboo M18 manga.png|thumb|200px|Inkay in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Inkay briefly appeared in ''{{ma|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages}}''. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Inkay is the first {{type|Dark}} Pokémon to be owned by {{TRT}}. * Inkay is the only one of James's Pokémon previously left at Team Rocket HQ to have never had his English voice actor changed. * Inkay has the lowest [[List of Pokémon by base stats|base stat total]] of any Pokémon owned by Team Rocket. * Inkay is the only Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} to have used the move {{m|Foul Play}}. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Inkay}} {{Team Rocket's Pokémon|dark|psychic}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:James's Pokémon|Inkay]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)|Inkay]] [[de:James’ Iscalar]] [[es:Inkay de James]] [[fr:Sepiatop de James]] [[it:Inkay di James]] [[ja:コジロウのマーイーカ]] [[zh:小次郎的好啦鱿]]
